policy: Real historical series only. Missing series are flagged and omitted from the chart, never interpolated or invented. Yahoo upgrades history is incomplete; empty is not proof of inactivity. Lead time is computed only from a documented dated entry (day or month-precision, labeled) to a real dated Street upgrade or earnings beat; modest same-rating target trims and already-constructive prior Street action do not create a lead. Month-precision placeholders are not exact entry days. COVID equity paths are not put P&L. Google Trends uses an explicit custom timeframe (not 'today 5-y'); values are relative 0–100 within that window.

entry.label: purchase screenshots at $1.56, viewed by BI

exit.label: full exit November 2020, stock $11.38 (BI); gradual selling around June ~$4.46

lead.zh: 这不是「卖方无知」的时差。2021 年 8 月 18 日《商业内幕》称截图显示 2020 年 4 月 24 日以名义价格 1.56 美元买入。发行人把二季报日期写为 2020 年 8 月 10 日收盘后（8 月 4 日的电话会通知写明新闻稿在 8 月 11 日电话会的前一天发布）。4 月 24 日到 8 月 10 日是 108 个日历日：从有记录的买入日到财报发布，不是评级滞后。Yahoo 把该行标成 2020 年 8 月 9 日（107 日），那是供应商的时间戳，不是发行人的。新闻稿写明调整后稀释每股收益 0.48 美元，报告稀释每股收益 0.34 美元。Yahoo 的 Surprise(%) +340 用的是预期 −0.20 和 0.48。新闻稿没有公布这组一致预期，所以 +340% 不是已确认的超预期，也不是股价涨幅。库存的 2020 年 4 月 24 日自动复权收盘约 0.69 美元。在调整因子、货币、证券身份和报价质量对齐之前，不能与 1.56 美元直接比较。更晚的每股 12 美元特别股息（2022 年 1 月 4 日新闻稿，2022 年 2 月 1 日支付）可能影响复权历史；它没有被证明就是这个价差的原因。窗口内 Yahoo 评级为空：证据不足，不是「卖方沉默」。复权收盘的事件研究路径，与每股收益、以及 BI 描述的 1.56 到 11.38 美元路径，是三件不同的事。
lead.en: Not a Street-ignorance lead. Business Insider (18 Aug 2021) said screenshots showed a 24 Apr 2020 purchase at a nominal $1.56. The issuer dated the Q2 release 10 Aug 2020, after the close (call notice dated 4 Aug 2020 said the release would come the day before the 11 Aug call). 24 Apr to 10 Aug is 108 calendar days: entry date to an earnings release, not a rating lag. Yahoo stamps the row 9 Aug 2020 (107 days). That is the vendor clock, not the issuer's. The release states adjusted diluted EPS of US$0.48 and reported diluted EPS of US$0.34. Yahoo Surprise(%) +340 uses estimate −0.20 and 0.48. The release does not publish that consensus, so +340% is not a confirmed beat and is not a stock return. The stored auto-adjusted close on 24 Apr 2020 is about $0.69. It is not comparable to $1.56 until adjustment factor, currency, security identity, and quote quality are reconciled. A later US$12 special dividend (issuer release 4 Jan 2022, payable 1 Feb 2022) can affect adjusted history; it is not a demonstrated explanation of this gap. Yahoo rating rows in the window are empty: insufficient evidence, not a silent Street. The adjusted-close event-study path is a different object from both the EPS line and the $1.56 to $11.38 path BI described.

cases.note: March 2019 observation recalled in Dec 2020. Purchase day unavailable. No trading lead.

lead.zh: 没有单一数字的交易时差：买入日未知。2019 年 3 月 15 日只是月中占位（到 4 月 3 日相隔 19 个日历日），不是成交证据。2020 年 12 月 7 日《商业内幕》访谈里，他回忆 2019 年 3 月看过 Jeffree Star 的视频；这是事后回忆，不是有日期的买入，视频上传日也没有独立来源。库存的 Google Trends 点 2019-03-03 = 100 是 2026 年 11 月 13 日拉取窗口里的周桶标签，不是第一信号的时间戳，本次没有重拉 Trends。该标签到 2019 年 4 月 3 日是 31 个日历日，不是他的领先时间。Motley Fool（2019 年 4 月 3 日）记载当天 Jefferies 的 Stephanie Wissink 上调并给出 14 美元目标价。原始 Jefferies 报告没有取得。Yahoo 另有由持有到买入、目标价 10 到 14 美元；这两个「之前」字段只来自 Yahoo。Fool 文章里的理由（维权股东、新 CFO、货架）不是 Jeffree Star 观察，所以上调不能证明卖方采纳了他的论点。发行人 2019 年 2 月 26 日的财年业绩（净销售 2.67 亿美元，下降 1%）是此前的公司背景，不是这条社会观察。短期搜索或视频观察不是利润、现金流或价值。
lead.en: No single-number trading lead: the purchase day is unknown. 15 Mar 2019 was only a mid-month placeholder (19 calendar days before 3 Apr) and is not execution evidence. In the 7 Dec 2020 Business Insider interview he recalled watching a Jeffree Star video in March 2019; that recollection is not a dated buy, and the video upload day was not independently sourced. The stored Google Trends point 2019-03-03 = 100 is a weekly bucket label inside a window pulled on 13 Nov 2026, not a first-signal timestamp, and this pass did not re-pull Trends. Calendar days from that label to 3 Apr 2019 are 31. That span is not his lead. Motley Fool (3 Apr 2019) reports a Jefferies upgrade that day by Stephanie Wissink with a $14 target. The original Jefferies note was not obtained. Yahoo also shows Hold to Buy and $10 to $14; those prior fields are Yahoo-only. The Fool article's reasons (activists, a new CFO, shelf space) are not the Jeffree Star observation, so the upgrade does not show the Street adopted his thesis. The issuer's 26 Feb 2019 release (fiscal 2018 net sales $267 million, down 1%) is prior context, not the social claim. A short-term search or video observation is not earnings, cash flow, or value.
